race.comment: VICTREE BUSTA (1) ran eighth last start at this track over 2040m, beaten 20 metres. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Must raise the bar but a win is not out of the question. DOOO DONT THINK (3) could only manage to finish ninth at his latest appearance over 2040m at this track, failing to live up to market expectations. No excuses from this advantageous draw. Stepping up a level this time but on his best form he is capable of a far better performance. SKYLAR BREE (5) was in the money two starts ago then things went amiss last start when she copped a check and broke. Worth another chance. MADAME WEST (7) is on the radar after her last-start fourth over 1780m at this track a week ago.
